name: TowBeam: буксировка в игре своей сборкой (старт, захват, полёт, отцепка, обрыв, склад, прыжок)

do.text: OrderTakeOff(Player());
SFT('lab: inspace ' + ShipInNormalSpace(Player()) + ' speed ' + ShipSpeed(Player()) + ' hook ' + ShipHookPower(Player()) + '/' + ShipHookRange(Player()));
OrderMove(Player(), CoordX(Player()) + 3000, CoordY(Player()));
SFT('lab: t1 ' + RunFunctionFromScript('TowBeam', 'State') + ' angle=' + ShipAngle(Player()) + ' speed=' + ShipSpeed(Player()));
SFT('lab: t2 ' + RunFunctionFromScript('TowBeam', 'State') + ' angle=' + ShipAngle(Player()) + ' block=' + ShipStatusEffect(Player(), 3));
OrderMove(Player(), CoordX(Player()), CoordY(Player()) - 3000);
SFT('lab: chain ' + RunFunctionFromScript('TowBeam', 'State') + ' angle=' + ShipAngle(Player()));
OrderTakeOff(Player());
SFT('lab: now star=' + Name(ShipStar(Player())) + ' inspace=' + ShipInNormalSpace(Player()) + ' state ' + RunFunctionFromScript('TowBeam', 'State'));
